page.title: List of Shikinaisha in Suruga Province

revision.comment: 各国の式内社表の掲載。ただし、式内比定社は現在名神大社のみの状態、国史見在社・式外社も未掲載の状態。
revision.text:
'''駿河国の式内社一覧'''（するがのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[延喜式]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[駿河国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また[[式外社]]として、当時すでに当国に存在したはずであるのに『延喜式神名帳』に記載の無い神社についても付記する。 == 式内社 == 『延喜式神名帳』には、大社1座1社（名神大社）・小社21座21社の計22座22社が記載。 {{注|（凡例）
1）「神名帳」列は、[http://kindai.ndl.go.jp/info:ndljp/pid/1442211 『延喜式 上巻』]（大岡山書店、昭和4年、近代デジタルライブラリー）等における『[[延喜式神名帳]]』の記載を基に作成。社名表記は[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/jinjaindex.html 神社史料集成]における字体（異体字がある場合には新字体・通用性の高い字体を使用）を基準とした。読みの「-」部分は、「神社」以外で仮名が振られていない部分。「○座」は座数を表し、一座の場合は記載していない。
2）格の「名神大」は[[名神大社]]を、「大」は式内大社（名神大社除く）を、「小」は式内小社を意味する。付記は社名とともに記されているもので、その主要なものについては「[[式内社#式内社の社格]]」を参照。
3）比定社が複数ある場合、最も有力なものを無冠で示し、他の論社には「（論）」を冠した。
4）本来の式内社とは認めがたいものの、式内社を合祀したなど、その後継を主張するもの、その他参考の神社には「（参）」を冠した。}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; white-space:nowrap" align="left" !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=4 | 式内社22座]（國學院大學21世紀COEプログラム「神道・神社史料集成」） {{式内社一覧}} [[Category:駿河国の式内社|*]]

'''駿河国の式内社一覧'''（するがのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[延喜式]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[駿河国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また[[式外社]]として、当時すでに当国に存在したはずであるのに『延喜式神名帳』に記載の無い神社についても付記する。 == 式内社 == 『延喜式神名帳』には、大社1座1社（名神大社）・小社21座21社の計22座22社が記載。 {{注|（凡例）
1）「神名帳」列は、[http://kindai.ndl.go.jp/info:ndljp/pid/1442211 『延喜式 上巻』]（大岡山書店、昭和4年、近代デジタルライブラリー）等における『[[延喜式神名帳]]』の記載を基に作成。社名表記は[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/jinjaindex.html 神社史料集成]（5を参照）における字体（異体字がある場合には新字体・通用性の高い字体を使用）を基準とした。読みの「-」部分は、「神社」以外で仮名が振られていない部分。「○座」は座数を表し、一座の場合は記載していない。
2）格の「名神大」は[[名神大社]]を、「大」は式内大社（名神大社除く）を、「小」は式内小社を意味する。付記は社名とともに記されているもので、その主要なものについては「[[式内社#式内社の社格]]」を参照。
3）比定社が複数ある場合、最も有力なものを無冠で示し、他の論社には「（論）」を冠した。
4）本来の式内社とは認めがたいものの、式内社を合祀したなど、その後継を主張するもの、その他参考の神社には「（参）」を冠した。
5）「集成」列は[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/jinjaindex.html 神社史料集成]（國學院大學21世紀COEプログラム「神道・神社史料集成」）における神社項へのリンク先を記載。}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; white-space:nowrap" '''駿河国の式内社一覧'''（するがのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[延喜式]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[駿河国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また[[式外社]]として、当時すでに当国に存在したはずであるのに『延喜式神名帳』に記載の無い神社についても付記する。 == 式内社 == 『延喜式神名帳』には、大社1座1社（名神大社）・小社21座21社の計22座22社が記載。 {{注|（凡例）
1）「神名帳」列は、[{{NDLDC|1442211}} 『延喜式 上巻』]（大岡山書店、昭和4年、近代デジタルライブラリー）等における『[[延喜式神名帳]]』の記載を基に作成。社名表記は[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/jinjaindex.html 神社史料集成]（5を参照）における字体（異体字がある場合には新字体・通用性の高い字体を使用）を基準とした。読みの「-」部分は、「神社」以外で仮名が振られていない部分。「○座」は座数を表し、一座の場合は記載していない。
2）格の「名神大」は[[名神大社]]を、「大」は式内大社（名神大社除く）を、「小」は式内小社を意味する。付記は社名とともに記されているもので、その主要なものについては「[[式内社#式内社の社格]]」を参照。
3）比定社が複数ある場合、最も有力なものを無冠で示し、他の論社には「（論）」を冠した。
4）本来の式内社とは認めがたいものの、式内社を合祀したなど、その後継を主張するもの、その他参考の神社には「（参）」を冠した。
5）「集成」列は[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/jinjaindex.html 神社史料集成]（國學院大學21世紀COEプログラム「神道・神社史料集成」）における神社項へのリンク先を記載。}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; white-space:nowrap" align="left" !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=4 | 神名帳 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=3 | 比定社 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" rowspan=2 | 集成 |- !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 社名 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 読み !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 格 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 付記 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 社名 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 所在地 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 備考 |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[益頭郡]]''' 4座（並小） |- |'''神神社'''||ミワノ||小|||||||||| |- |'''飽波神社'''||アクナミ||小|||||||||| |- |'''那閉神社'''||アヘノ||小|||||||||| |- |'''焼津神社'''||ヤキツノ||小||||[[焼津神社]]||[[静岡県]][[焼津市]]焼津|||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[有度郡]]''' 3座（並小） |- |'''伊河麻神社'''||イカマ||小|||||||||| |- |'''池田神社'''||イケタノ||小|||||||||| |- |'''草薙神社'''||クサナキノ||小||||[[草薙神社]]||静岡県[[静岡市]][[清水区]]草薙|||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[安倍郡]]''' 7座（並小） |- |'''足坏神社'''||アシツキノ||小|||||||||| |- |'''神部神社'''||カムヘノ||小||||[[静岡浅間神社|神部神社]]||静岡県静岡市[[葵区]]宮ケ崎町||駿河国[[総社]]

'''駿河国の式内社一覧'''（するがのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[延喜式]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[駿河国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また『延喜式』神名帳の編纂当時に存在したが同帳に記載の無い神社、いわゆる「[[式外社]]」についても付記する。 == 式内社 == {{節stub}} 『延喜式』神名帳では、大社1座1社（名神大社）・小社21座21社の計22座22社を記載。 {{式内社一覧/凡例}} {{式内社一覧/header}} |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[益頭郡]]''' 4座（並小） |- |'''神神社'''||ミワノ||小||||[[神神社]]||[[静岡県]][[藤枝市]]岡部町三輪|||| |- |'''飽波神社'''||アクナミ||小||||[[飽波神社]]||静岡県藤枝市藤枝|||| |- |'''那閉神社'''||アヘノ||小||||[[那閉神社]]||静岡県[[焼津市]]浜当目|||| |- |'''焼津神社'''||ヤキツノ||小||||[[焼津神社]]||静岡県焼津市焼津|||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[有度郡]]''' 3座（並小） |- |'''伊河麻神社'''||イカマ||小||||[[伊河麻神社]]||静岡県[[静岡市]][[駿河区]]稲川|||| |- |'''池田神社'''||イケタノ||小||||[[池田神社 (静岡市)|池田神社]]||静岡県[[静岡市]][[駿河区]]池田|||| |- |'''草薙神社'''||クサナキノ||小||||[[草薙神社]]||静岡県[[静岡市]][[清水区]]草薙|||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[安倍郡]]''' 7座（並小） |- |'''足坏神社'''||アシツキノ||小||||[[足坏神社]]||静岡県[[静岡市]][[葵区]]足久保奥組|||| |- |'''神部神社'''||カムヘノ||小||||[[静岡浅間神社|神部神社]]||静岡県静岡市[[葵区]]宮ケ崎町||駿河国[[総社]]

[[ファイル:Engishiki cropped Engishiki Vol 2 Flame 69.jpg|thumb|300px|日本古典全集に収録された『延喜式』巻9の「駿河國」の部分[[正宗敦夫]]編纂『延喜式』2巻、日本古典全集刊行會、1929年、129頁。]] '''駿河国の式内社一覧'''（するがのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[延喜式]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[駿河国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また『延喜式』神名帳の編纂当時に存在したが同帳に記載の無い神社、いわゆる「[[式外社]]」についても付記する。 == 式内社 == {{節stub}} 『延喜式』神名帳では、大社1座1社（名神大社）・小社21座21社の計22座22社を記載。 {{式内社一覧/凡例}} {{式内社一覧/header}} |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[益頭郡]]''' 4座（並小） |- |'''神神社'''||ミワノ||小||||[[神神社 (藤枝市)|神神社]]||[[静岡県]][[藤枝市]]岡部町三輪|||| |- |'''飽波神社'''||アクナミ||小||||[[飽波神社]]||静岡県藤枝市藤枝|||| |- |'''那閉神社'''||アヘノ||小||||[[那閉神社]]||静岡県[[焼津市]]浜当目|||| |- |'''焼津神社'''||ヤキツノ||小||||[[焼津神社]]||静岡県焼津市焼津|||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[有度郡]]''' 3座（並小） |- |'''伊河麻神社'''||イカマ||小||||[[伊河麻神社]]||静岡県[[静岡市]][[駿河区]]稲川|||| |- |'''池田神社'''||イケタノ||小||||[[池田神社 (静岡市)|池田神社]]||静岡県[[静岡市]][[駿河区]]池田|||| |- |'''草薙神社'''||クサナキノ||小||||[[草薙神社]]||静岡県[[静岡市]][[清水区]]草薙|||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[安倍郡]]''' 7座（並小） |- |'''足坏神社'''||アシツキノ||小||||[[足坏神社]]||静岡県[[静岡市]][[葵区]]足久保奥組|||| |- |'''神部神社'''||カムヘノ||小||||[[静岡浅間神社|神部神社]]||静岡県静岡市[[葵区]]宮ケ崎町||駿河国[[総社]]

[[File:Engishiki cropped Engishiki Vol 2 Flame 69.jpg|thumb|300px|日本古典全集に収録された『延喜式』巻9の「駿河國」の部分[[正宗敦夫]]編纂『延喜式』2巻、日本古典全集刊行會、1929年、129頁。]] '''駿河国の式内社一覧'''（するがのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[Engishiki]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[駿河国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また『延喜式』神名帳の編纂当時に存在したが同帳に記載の無い神社、いわゆる「[[式外社]]」についても付記する。 == 式内社 == {{節stub}} 『延喜式』神名帳では、大社1座1社（Myojin Taisha社）・小社21座21社の計22座22社を記載。 {{式内社一覧/凡例}} {{List of Shikinai Shrines/header}} |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[益頭郡]]''' 4座（並小） |- |'''神神社'''||ミワノ||Shikinai Shosha||||[[神神社 (藤枝市)|神神社]]||[[静岡県]][[藤枝市]]岡部町三輪|||| |- |'''飽波神社'''||アクナミ||Shikinai Shosha||||[[飽波神社]]||静岡県藤枝市藤枝|||| |- |'''那閉神社'''||アヘノ||Shikinai Shosha||||[[那閉神社]]||静岡県[[焼津市]]浜当目|||| |- |'''焼津神社'''||ヤキツノ||Shikinai Shosha||||[[焼津神社]]||静岡県焼津市焼津|||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[有度郡]]''' 3座（並小） |- |'''伊河麻神社'''||イカマ||Shikinai Shosha||||[[伊河麻神社]]||静岡県[[静岡市]][[駿河区]]稲川|||| |- |'''池田神社'''||イケタノ||Shikinai Shosha||||[[池田神社 (静岡市)|池田神社]]||静岡県[[静岡市]][[駿河区]]池田|||| |- |'''草薙神社'''||クサナキノ||Shikinai Shosha||||[[草薙神社]]||静岡県[[静岡市]][[清水区]]草薙|||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[安倍郡]]''' 7座（並小） |- |'''足坏神社'''||アシツキノ||Shikinai Shosha||||[[足坏神社]]||静岡県[[静岡市]][[葵区]]足久保奥組|||| |- |'''神部神社'''||カムヘノ||Shikinai Shosha||||[[静岡浅間神社|神部神社]]||静岡県静岡市[[葵区]]宮ケ崎町||駿河国[[総社]]

In addition, shrines that existed at the time of compilation of the ''Engishiki'' but are not recorded therein—the so-called {{ill|Shikigai Shrines|de|Shikigai Shrines|ja|式外社|zh|式外社}}—are also noted. In addition, shrines that existed at the time of compilation of the ''Engishiki'' but are not recorded therein—the so-called {{ill|Shikigai Shrines|de|Shikigai Shrines|ja|式外社|zh|式外社|12=draft}}—are also noted. == Shikinai Shrines == {{節stub}} In the ''Engishiki'', a total of 1 group and 1 major shrine (a Myojin Taisha) and 21 groups and 21 minor shrines (22 groups and 22 shrines in all) are also noted. == Shikinai Shrines == {{節stub}} In the ''Engishiki'', a total of 1 group and 1 major shrine (a Myojin Taisha) and 21 groups and 21 minor shrines (22 groups and 22 shrines in all) are Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below{{ill|Immanuelle|de|Immanuelle|ja|Immanuelle|zh|Immanuelle|12=draft}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle|12=draft}}) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} [[File:Engishiki cropped Engishiki Vol 2 Flame 69.jpg|thumb|300px|Portion of "Suruga Province" from Volume 9 of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式|12=draft}}, as included in the {{ill|Nihon Kokuten Shū|de|Nihon Kokuten Shū|ja|日本古典全集|zh|日本古典全集|12=draft}}{{ill|Masamune Atsuo|de|Masamune Atsuo|ja|正宗敦夫|zh|正宗敦夫|12=draft}} ed., Vol. 2 of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式|12=draft}}, {{ill|Nihon Kokuten Shū|de|Nihon Kokuten Shū|ja|日本古典全集|zh|日本古典全集|12=draft}}, 1929, p. 129.]] '''{{ill|List of Shikinaisha in Suruga Province|de|List of Shikinaisha in Suruga Province|ja|駿河国の式内社一覧|zh|駿河国の式内社一覧|12=draft}}''' is a list of {{ill|Shinto shrines|de|Shinto shrines|ja|神社|zh|神社|12=draft}}, namely the so-called {{ill|Shikinai Shrines|de|Shikinai Shrines|ja|式内社|zh|式内社|12=draft}} and their associated {{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社|lt=candidate|12=draft|12=draft}}, as recorded in Volumes 9 and 10 ("Kamimyōchō Jōge") of the ''{{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式|12=draft}}'', which are classified as belonging to {{ill|Suruga Province|de|Suruga Province|ja|駿河国|zh|駿河国|12=draft}}. In addition, shrines that existed at the time of compilation of the ''Engishiki'' but are not recorded therein—the so-called {{ill|Shikigai Shrines|de|Shikigai Shrines|ja|式外社|zh|式外社|12=draft}}—are also noted. == Shikinai Shrines == In the ''Engishiki'', a total of 1 group and 1 major shrine (a Myojin Taisha) and 21 groups and 21 minor shrines (22 groups and 22 shrines in all) are recorded. In addition, shrines that existed at the time of compilation of the ''Engishiki'' but are not recorded therein—the so-called {{ill|Shikigai Shrines|de|Shikigai Shrines|ja|式外社|zh|式外社|12=draft}}—are also noted. == Shikinai Shrines == In the ''Engishiki'', a total of 1 group and 1 major shrine (a Myojin Taisha) and 21 groups and 21 minor shrines (22 groups and 22 shrines in all) are recorded. In addition, shrines that existed at the time of compilation of the ''Engishiki'' but are not recorded therein—the so-called {{ill|Shikigai Shrines|de|Shikigai Shrines|ja|式外社|zh|式外社|12=draft}}—are also noted. == Shikinai Shrines == In the ''Engishiki'', a total of 1 group and 1 major shrine (a Myojin Taisha) and 21 groups and 21 minor shrines (22 groups and 22 shrines in all) are recorded. In addition, shrines that existed at the time of compilation of the ''Engishiki'' but are not recorded therein—the so-called {{ill|Shikigai Shrines|de|Shikigai Shrines|ja|式外社|zh|式外社|12=draft}}—are also noted. == Shikinai Shrines == In the ''Engishiki'', a total of 1 group and 1 major shrine (a Myojin Taisha) and 21 groups and 21 minor shrines (22 groups and 22 shrines in all) are recorded. In addition, shrines that existed at the time of compilation of the ''Engishiki'' but are not recorded therein—the so-called {{ill|Shikigai Shrines|de|Shikigai Shrines|ja|式外社|zh|式外社|12=draft}}—are also noted. == Shikinai Shrines == In the ''Engishiki'', a total of 1 group and 1 major shrine (a Myojin Taisha) and 21 groups and 21 minor shrines (22 groups and 22 shrines in all) are recorded. In addition, shrines that existed at the time of compilation of the ''Engishiki'' but are not recorded therein—the so-called {{ill|Shikigai Shrines|de|Shikigai Shrines|ja|式外社|zh|式外社|12=draft}}—are also noted. == Shikinai Shrines == In the ''Engishiki'', a total of 1 group and 1 major shrine (a Myojin Taisha) and 21 groups and 21 minor shrines (22 groups and 22 shrines in all) are recorded. In addition, shrines that existed at the time of compilation of the ''Engishiki'' but are not recorded therein—the so-called {{ill|Shikigai Shrines|de|Shikigai Shrines|ja|式外社|zh|式外社|12=draft}}—are also noted. == Shikinai Shrines == In the ''Engishiki'', a total of 1 group and 1 major shrine (a Myojin Taisha) and 21 groups and 21 minor shrines (22 groups and 22 shrines in all) are recorded. Province|de|List of Shikinaisha in Suruga Province|ja|駿河国の式内社一覧|zh|駿河国の式内社一覧|12=draft}}''' is a list of {{ill|Shinto shrines|de|Shinto shrines|ja|神社|zh|神社|12=draft}}, namely the so-called {{ill|Shikinai Shrines|de|Shikinai Shrines|ja|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|zh|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|12=draft}} and their associated {{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社|lt=candidate|12=draft|12=draft}}, as recorded in Volumes 9 and 10 ("Kamimyōchō Jōge") of the ''{{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式|12=draft}}'', which are classified as belonging to {{ill|Suruga Province|de|Suruga Province|ja|駿河国|zh|駿河国|12=draft}}. In addition, shrines that existed at the time of compilation of the ''Engishiki'' but are not recorded therein—the so-called {{ill|Shikigai Shrines|de|Shikigai Shrines|ja|式外社|zh|式外社|12=draft}}—are also noted. == Shikinai Shrines == In the ''Engishiki'', a total of 1 group and 1 major shrine (a Myojin Taisha) and 21 groups and 21 minor shrines (22 groups and 22 shrines in all) are recorded. also noted. == Shikinai Shrines == In the ''Engishiki'', a total of 1 group and 1 major shrine (a Myojin Taisha) and 21 groups and 21 minor shrines (22 groups and 22 shrines in all) are recorded. {{ill|Shikinai Shrines|de|Shikinai Shrines|ja|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|zh|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|12=draft}} and their associated {{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社|lt=candidate|12=draft|12=draft}}, as recorded in Volumes 9 and 10 ("Kamimyōchō Jōge") of the ''{{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式|12=draft}}'', which are classified as belonging to {{ill|Suruga Province|de|Suruga Province|ja|駿河国|zh|駿河国|12=draft}}. In addition, shrines that existed at the time of compilation of the ''Engishiki'' but are not recorded therein—the so-called {{ill|Shikigai Shrines|de|Shikigai Shrines|ja|式外社|zh|式外社|12=draft}}—are also noted. == Shikinai Shrines == In the ''Engishiki'', a total of 1 group and 1 major shrine (a Myojin Taisha) and 21 groups and 21 minor shrines (22 groups and 22 shrines in all) are recorded. {{ill|Shikinai Shrines|de|Shikinai Shrines|ja|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|zh|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|12=draft}} and their associated {{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社|lt=candidate|12=draft|12=draft}}, as recorded in Volumes 9 and 10 ("Kamimyōchō Jōge") of the ''{{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式|12=draft}}'', which are classified as belonging to {{ill|Suruga Province|de|Suruga Province|ja|駿河国|zh|駿河国|12=draft}}. In addition, shrines that existed at the time of compilation of the ''Engishiki'' but are not recorded therein—the so-called {{ill|Shikigai Shrines|de|Shikigai Shrines|ja|式外社|zh|式外社|12=draft}}—are also noted. == Shikinai Shrines == In the ''Engishiki'', a total of 1 group and 1 major shrine (a Myojin Taisha) and 21 groups and 21 minor shrines (22 groups and 22 shrines in all) are recorded. Province|ja|駿河国|zh|駿河国|12=draft}}. {{ill|Shikinai Shrines|de|Shikinai Shrines|ja|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|zh|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|12=draft}} and their associated {{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社|lt=candidate|12=draft|12=draft}}, as recorded in Province|ja|駿河国|zh|駿河国|12=draft}}. In addition, shrines that existed at the time of compilation of the ''Engishiki'' but are not recorded therein—the so-called {{ill|Shikigai Shrines|de|Shikigai Shrines|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|zh|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft}}—are also noted. == Shikinai Shrines == In the ''Engishiki'', a total of 1 group and 1 major shrine (a Myojin Taisha) and 21 groups and 21 Province|ja|駿河国|zh|駿河国|12=draft}}. In addition, shrines that existed at the time of compilation of the ''Engishiki'' but are not recorded therein—the so-called {{ill|Shikigai Shrines|de|Shikigai Shrines|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|zh|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft}}—are also noted. == Shikinai Shrines == In the ''Engishiki'', a total of 1 group and 1 major shrine (a Myojin Taisha) and 21 groups and 21 [[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]]This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Suruga Province'''. Or the list of shrines in Suruga Province which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft|12=draft}} of Suruga Province which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. [[Category:Shikinaisha top]][[Category:Shikinaisha top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]]This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Suruga Province'''. Or the list of shrines in Suruga Province which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft|12=draft}} of Suruga Province which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. [[Category:Shikinaisha top]][[Category:Shikinaisha top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]]This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Suruga Province'''. Or the list of shrines in Suruga Province which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft|12=draft}} of Suruga Province which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. Or the list of shrines in [[Suruga Province which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft|12=draft}} of Suruga Province which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. Or the list of shrines in [[Suruga Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft|12=draft}} of [[Suruga Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. Or the list of shrines in [[Suruga Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. [[Category:Shikinaisha top]][[Category:Shikinaisha top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]]This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Suruga Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Suruga Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha}} of [[Suruga Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion.[[Category:edited lists]] [[Category:Lists of Shikinaisha by location]] == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the ''Engishiki'', a total of 1 group Or the list of shrines in [[Suruga Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳}}. Or the list of shrines in [[Suruga Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳}}. Or the list of shrines in [[Suruga Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha}} of [[Suruga Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳}}. Or the list of shrines in [[Suruga Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳}}. [[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]]This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Suruga Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Suruga Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft}} of [[Suruga Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the ''Engishiki'', a total of 1 group and 1 major shrine (a Myojin Taisha) and 21 groups and 21 minor shrines [[Category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]][[Category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]]This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Suruga Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Suruga Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft}} of [[Suruga Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the ''Engishiki'', a total of 1 group and 1 major shrine (a Myojin Taisha) and 21 groups and 21 minor shrines (22 groups and 22 shrines in all) are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=4 | {{ill|Engishiki This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Suruga Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Suruga Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft}} of [[Suruga Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the ''Engishiki'', a total of 1 group and 1 major shrine (a Myojin Taisha) and 21 groups and 21 minor shrines (22 groups and 22 shrines in all) are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=4 | {{ill|Engishiki revision.text:
This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Suruga Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Suruga Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft}} of [[Suruga Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the ''Engishiki'', a total of 1 group and 1 major shrine (a Myojin Taisha) and 21 groups and 21 minor shrines (22 groups and 22 shrines in all) are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=4 | {{ill|Engishiki This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Suruga Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Suruga Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft}} of [[Suruga Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the ''Engishiki'', a total of 1 group and 1 major shrine (a Myojin Taisha) and 21 groups and 21 minor shrines (22 groups and 22 shrines in all) are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=4 | {{ill|Engishiki This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Suruga Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Suruga Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft}} of [[Suruga Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the ''Engishiki'', a total of 1 group and 1 major shrine (a Myojin Taisha) and 21 groups and 21 minor shrines (22 groups and 22 shrines in all) are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=4 | {{ill|Engishiki This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Suruga Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Suruga Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Suruga Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the ''Engishiki'', a total of 1 group and 1 major shrine (a Myojin Taisha) and 21 groups and 21 minor shrines (22 groups and 22 shrines in all) are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=4 | {{ill|Engishiki This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Suruga Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Suruga Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Suruga Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the ''Engishiki'', a total of 1 group and 1 major shrine (a Myojin Taisha) and 21 groups and 21 minor shrines (22 groups and 22 shrines in all) are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=4 | {{ill|Engishiki This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Suruga Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Suruga Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Suruga Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the ''Engishiki'', a total of 1 group and 1 major shrine (a Myojin Taisha) and 21 groups and 21 minor shrines (22 groups and 22 shrines in all) are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=4 | {{ill|Engishiki revision.text:
This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Suruga Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Suruga Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Suruga Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the ''Engishiki'', a total of 1 group and 1 major shrine (a Myojin Taisha) and 21 groups and 21 minor shrines (22 groups and 22 shrines in all) are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=4 | {{ill|Engishiki This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Suruga Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Suruga Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Suruga Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the ''Engishiki'', a total of 1 group and 1 major shrine (a Myojin Taisha) and 21 groups and 21 minor shrines (22 groups and 22 shrines in all) are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=4 | {{ill|Engishiki This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Suruga Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Suruga Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Suruga Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the ''Engishiki'', a total of 1 group and 1 major shrine (a Myojin Taisha) and 21 groups and 21 minor shrines (22 groups and 22 shrines in all) are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=4 | {{ill|Engishiki This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Suruga Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Suruga Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Suruga Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Suruga Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Suruga Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Suruga Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the ''Engishiki'', a total of 1 group and 1 major shrine (a Myojin Taisha) and 21 groups and 21 minor shrines This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Suruga Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Suruga Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Suruga Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the ''Engishiki'', a total of 1 group and 1 major shrine (a Myojin Taisha) and 21 groups and 21 minor shrines (22 groups and 22 shrines in all) are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=4 | {{ill|Engishiki This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Suruga Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Suruga Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Suruga Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the ''Engishiki'', a total of 1 group and 1 major shrine (a Myojin Taisha) and 21 groups and 21 minor shrines (22 groups and 22 shrines in all) are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=4 | {{ill|Engishiki This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Suruga Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Suruga Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|qq=}} of [[Suruga Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the ''Engishiki'', a total of 1 group and 1 major shrine (a Myojin Taisha) and 21 groups and 21 minor shrines revision.text:
This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Suruga Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Suruga Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|qq=}} of [[Suruga Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinaisha (式内社) == In the ''Engishiki'', a total of 1 group and 1 major shrine (a Myojin Taisha) and 21 groups and 21 minor shrines (22 groups and 22 shrines in all) are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=4 | {{ill|Engishiki This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Suruga Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Suruga Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|qq=}} of [[Suruga Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Suruga Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Suruga Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|qq=}} of [[Suruga Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinaisha (式内社) == In the ''Engishiki'', a total of 1 group and 1 major shrine (a Myojin Taisha) and 21 groups and 21 minor shrines (22 revision.text:
This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Suruga Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Suruga Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|qq=}} of [[Suruga Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinaisha (式内社) == In the ''Engishiki'', a total of 1 group and 1 major shrine (a Myojin Taisha) and 21 groups and 21 minor shrines (22 groups and 22 shrines in all) are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=4 | {{ill|Engishiki revision.text:
This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Suruga Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Suruga Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|qq=}} of [[Suruga Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinaisha (式内社) == In the ''Engishiki'', a total of 1 group and 1 major shrine (a Myojin Taisha) and 21 groups and 21 minor shrines (22 This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Suruga Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Suruga Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Suruga Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Suruga Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. Or the list of shrines in [[Suruga Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Suruga Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Suruga Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Suruga Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Suruga Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Suruga Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Suruga Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 延喜式神名帳|comment=enwiki is a redirect}} of [[Suruga Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinaisha (式内社) == In the ''Engishiki'', a total of 1 group and 1 major shrine (a Myojin Taisha) and 21 groups and 21 minor shrines (22 revision.text:
This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Suruga Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Suruga Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 延喜式神名帳|comment=enwiki is a redirect}} of [[Suruga Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinaisha (式内社) == In the ''Engishiki'', a total of 1 group and 1 major shrine (a Myojin Taisha) and 21 groups and 21 minor shrines (22 This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Suruga Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[:en:Suruga Province|Suruga Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 延喜式神名帳|comment=enwiki is a redirect}} of [[:en:Suruga Province|Suruga Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinaisha (式内社) == In the ''Engishiki'', a total of 1 group and 1 major shrine (a Myojin Taisha) and 21 groups and 21 minor shrines (22 Or the list of shrines in [[:en:Suruga Province|Suruga Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Suruga Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 22 Shikinaisha in the province – 21 Shikinai Shosha and 1 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Suruga Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 22 Shikinaisha in the province – 21 Shikinai Shosha and 1 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Suruga Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 22 Shikinaisha in the province – 21 Shikinai Shosha and 1 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Suruga Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 22 Shikinaisha in the province – 21 Shikinai Shosha and 1 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Suruga Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 22 Shikinaisha in the province – 21 Shikinai Shosha and 1 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Suruga Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 22 Shikinaisha in the province – 21 Shikinai Shosha and 1 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Suruga Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 22 Shikinaisha in the province – 21 Shikinai Shosha and 1 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Suruga Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 22 Shikinaisha in the province – 21 Shikinai Shosha and 1 Shikinai Taisha.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 22 Shikinaisha in the province – 21 Shikinai Shosha and 1 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Suruga Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 22 Shikinaisha in the province – 21 Shikinai Shosha and 1 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Suruga Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 22 Shikinaisha in the province – 21 Shikinai Shosha and 1 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Suruga Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 22 Shikinaisha in the province – 21 Shikinai Shōsha and 1 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Suruga Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 22 Shikinaisha in the province – 21 Shikinai Shōsha and 1 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Suruga Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 22 Shikinaisha in the province – 21 Shikinai Shosha and 1 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Suruga Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 22 Shikinaisha in the province – 21 Shikinai Shosha and 1 Shikinai Taisha.
